title: pilosella hypeurya subsp. lasiothrix
intro: Pilosella hypeurya subsp. lasiothrix, commonly known as Alpine Mouse-ear, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella hypeurya subsp. lasiothrix include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
